message.thinking:
We need to review candidate.py against contract: append_batch(store, values). Both lists of integers. Accept only non-negative values. If any negative, raise ValueError and leave store unchanged; otherwise append all values in order. Candidate: loops values, if value >=0 append else raise. This matches: negative cause exception, but note: the spec says if any negative, raise and leave store unchanged. Candidate will raise after encountering first negative, but has already appended any preceding non-negative values. That would mutate store before raising, violating contract: store should remain unchanged if any negative in batch. In test_invalid_first_value, first value negative, no earlier appends, so store unchanged. But if batch like [1, -1, 2], candidate would append 1, then raise on -1, leaving store with appended 1, violating contract. So defect.

Also spec says validation and mutation single-threaded - no concurrency issues here.

Thus one finding: candidate.py line 3-6 maybe lines where negative check is. We should point to line 3 as start. Or whole function lines 1-6. Provide severity high.
